source: Fresh native cluster creation using the compiled EKS advertised-endpoint fix; actual Kubernetes API, workload exec and owned cleanup.
setupRecovery: The initial harness used CLI --version, which printed the CLI version before any EKS call; corrected to cli-input-json. Fresh native creation then succeeded. k3d archive import left the workload image unavailable; imported the existing offline archive through the established worker ctr images import path and resumed this same cluster. No native server configuration was edited.
